desc: The Bulldog Hunter Series Rifle Case is designed for hunters and shooters seeking superior protection and functionality. Built with heavy-duty padding, this case ensures your firearm is shielded from impact, scratches, and the elements. It features multiple zippered storage pockets for accessories like magazines, ammunition, and gear, while the adjustable shoulder strap and reinforced carry handle provide comfortable transport. The full-length zipper allows for quick and easy firearm access. Designed for rifles up to 46 inches in length (external dimensions measure 48 inches, but deduct 2 inches for best firearm fit), this case is a durable and convenient storage solution for any hunting or shooting trip.
